title: Corporate Trainer
description:
We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced **Corporate Trainer** to design and deliver engaging training programs for corporate employees, freshers, and professionals. The role is open to candidates with expertise in **either IT/Technical Training or Non\-IT/Corporate Training**.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and deliver engaging training sessions through online and offline modes.
* Develop training materials, presentations, activities, assessments, and practical exercises.
* Customize training content based on learner and organizational requirements.
* Conduct workshops and interactive sessions using real\-world examples and case studies.
* Assess participant performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Track training effectiveness and prepare training reports when required.
* Coordinate with HR and internal teams to understand training requirements.
* Continuously update training content based on industry trends and organizational needs.

**IT/Technical Training areas may include:** Python, Java, C/C\+\+, SQL, Web Development, Data Analytics, Data Science, AI/ML, Cloud, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and other relevant technologies.

**Non\-IT/Corporate Training areas may include:** Communication Skills, Business Communication, Presentation Skills, Public Speaking, Leadership, Team Building, Soft Skills, Customer Service, Sales, Professional Etiquette, Interview Skills, Employability Skills, Time Management, and Workplace Behaviour.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any relevant discipline.
* 1–5 years of experience as a Corporate Trainer, Technical Trainer, Soft Skills Trainer, Faculty, or Learning \& Development professional.
* Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to engage different types of audiences and explain concepts clearly.
* Comfortable conducting both online and offline training sessions.
* Strong expertise in at least one IT or Non\-IT training domain.

**Candidates with expertise in either IT or Non\-IT Corporate Training are welcome to apply.**

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Data Architect
description:
**Skillsets Required: Data Architecture, AWS/GCP/Azure, Data Lake, ETL, SQL, Snowflake.**


### **Roles Responsibilities:**


**Job Summary:**


We are seeking an experienced **Data Architect**to design, develop, and optimize our enterprise data architecture. This role involves creating robust data models, ensuring data integrity and security, and enabling efficient data storage and retrieval to support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**Design and Develop Data Architecture:**

title: Lead Engineer
description:
As a Java Application Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining high\-quality Java web applications that support business transaction and reporting needs. You will collaborate with team members to determine design specifications, participate in code reviews, and contribute to internal infrastructure and process improvements. Your role will require strong technical competency, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in an environment that values quality, commitment, growth, and innovation. You will also assist with production problem resolution as needed, including occasional off\-hour support.**Application \& API Development**:

* Develop Java web applications and RESTful APIs, performing technical design, code development, documentation, and test plan generation.
* Design and implement solutions following microservices architecture and established design patterns (e.g., Dependency Injection, Repository pattern).
* Maintain a sustained track record of delivering high\-quality solutions on time and within budget.
**Cloud\-Native Development \& DevOps**:

* Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (primary) and Microsoft Azure.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes.
**Application Security**:

* Follow secure coding practices to protect against common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, including SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF).
* Implement authentication and authorization using industry standards such as OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
* Monitor and remediate security vulnerabilities in application dependencies and third\-party packages.
* Support compliance and data protection requirements applicable to the application.
**Data Management**:

* Store, retrieve, and manipulate data related to web applications for transactions and reporting.
* Design database schemas and optimize queries for performance and data integrity.
**Testing \& Quality Assurance**:

* Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests, and participate in code reviews to uphold coding standards.
* Troubleshoot, bug\-fix, and validate application behavior across the development lifecycle.
**Cross\-Functional \& Agile Collaboration**:

* Collaborate with product owners, designers, and fellow developers in Agile/Scrum teams to determine design specifications and technical details.
* Work together with colleagues on internal infrastructure and process improvements.
**Application Maintenance \& Optimization**:

* Modify existing applications to correct errors, adapt to new software upgrades, or improve performance.
**Production Support**:

* Assist in production problem resolution as needed, including occasional off\-hour support.
**Key Competencies:**

**Technical Expertise**:

* In\-depth working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Hibernate/JPA, with current experience on Java 17/Java 21 (LTS) and Spring Boot 4\.x.
* Modern front\-end proficiency in React (with Next.js) and/or Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/component\-based UI design; legacy jQuery/JavaScript experience a plus.
* AI\-assisted development skills, including GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini for day\-to\-day coding, and experience building or integrating AI features using Google Vertex AI and Spring AI.
* Cloud development and deployment experience with Google Cloud Platform (primary) — including Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Functions — with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS as a plus.
* Database experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MS SQL Server, including schema design, query performance tuning, and data migration.
* Experience developing and automating unit tests using JUnit 5 and/or TestNG, with mocking/assertion libraries such as Mockito and AssertJ.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to support continuous testing and delivery.
* Experience with code management tools (e.g., Git, SVN) and website performance testing.
**Domain and Support Experience**:

* Automobile domain experience.
* Experience supporting global applications.
**Attention to Detail and Multitasking**:

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly.
**Additional Tools Knowledge (a plus)**:

* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, Dynatrace, Postman, SonarQube, and JMeter.
**Technology Application**:

* Apply strong web development experience in Java Technologies to build and support mid\- to high\-scale internet web sites.
**Quality Assurance**:

* Perform website performance testing and ensure solutions meet quality, performance, and reliability standards.
**Certifications and Continued Growth (Desired but not** **required****)**:

* Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Developer.
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer certification.
* Knowledge of other programming languages.
* Knowledge of Content Management Systems.
* Mobile application development.

title: Deputy Process Specilaist
description:
**Intercompany Specialist**

**Job Purpose**

The Intercompany Specialist is responsible for managing end\-to\-end intercompany accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation, accurate financial reporting, effective dispute resolution, and governance of intercompany transactions across global legal entities. The role partners with Finance Controllers, Operations Teams, and Global Process Owners while leveraging digital tools, analytics, and AI\-driven solutions to enhance process efficiency, transparency, and control.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Intercompany Accounting \& Reconciliations**

* Perform intercompany GL reconciliations for all legal entities across SAP and Non\-SAP systems.
* Prepare and validate intercompany accrual calculations during month\-end and year\-end close.
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation mismatches, accounting discrepancies, and open items.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

**Balance Monitoring \& Resolution**

* Monitor ageing intercompany balances and identify overdue or unresolved transactions.
* Drive timely follow\-up and resolution of disputes, mismatches, and outstanding balances.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis on recurring reconciling items and implement preventive actions.
* Maintain complete visibility of intercompany balances and provide regular reporting to stakeholders.

**Invoicing \& Transaction Management**

* Coordinate non\-trade intercompany invoicing activities across legal entities.
* Ensure timely processing, validation, settlement, and reconciliation of intercompany invoices.
* Support business stakeholders in resolving transaction\-related queries and accounting issues.

**Stakeholder Management \& Governance**

* Facilitate periodic review meetings with Unit Finance Controllers, Operations Teams, and Global Process Owners.
* Discuss intercompany balances, accruals, disputes, open items, ageing, and reconciliation status.
* Track action items and ensure accountability for timely resolution.
* Prepare governance reports, dashboards, and management updates.

**Digitalization, Analytics \& AI**

* Leverage AI tools and automation technologies to improve reconciliation efficiency, exception management, and reporting accuracy.
* Utilize data analytics to identify trends, anomalies, ageing risks, and process improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation and adoption of AI\-powered solutions for financial analysis, dispute management, and balance monitoring.
* Drive continuous learning and adoption of emerging AI technologies within Finance operations.
* Collaborate with Digital, Finance Transformation, and Process Excellence teams to automate manual activities and enhance controls.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities for process standardization, optimization, and automation.
* Support transformation initiatives focused on intercompany process excellence.
* Contribute to improvements in KPIs, SLA performance, and financial control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of experience in Intercompany Accounting, General Ledger, R2R, or Shared Services Finance operations.
* Experience with SAP ERP and financial reconciliation tools preferred.
* Exposure to digital finance transformation and automation initiatives is an advantage.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

**Functional Skills**

* Intercompany Accounting
* General Ledger Reconciliations
* Financial Close \& Accrual Accounting
* Financial Reporting
* Dispute Management
* Root Cause Analysis
* SAP / ERP Systems
* Stakeholder Management

**Digital \& AI Skills**

* AI Literacy and AI Adoption Mindset
* Data Analytics and Visualization (Power BI preferred)
* Microsoft Copilot / Generative AI tools
* Process Automation (Power Automate, RPA awareness)
* Data\-driven Decision Making
* Digital Transformation \& Continuous Improvement

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration \& Influencing Skills
* Customer Focus
* Continuous Learning Mindset
* Proactive Ownership and Accountability

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and troubleshooting skills.

Grow your career through enterprise\-scale D365 Finance \& Operations development, customization, integrations, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.

Work with experienced functional consultants, project managers, technical specialists, and cross\-functional teams in a collaborative, innovation\-focused environment.

title: Technical Specialist – Salesforce Revenue Cloud
description:
**Are you an experienced Salesforce professional looking to build your expertise in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and enterprise Quote\-to\-Cash transformation?**


Join **LevelShift as a Technical Specialist Salesforce Revenue Cloud,** where you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions. You'll work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, QA, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and deliver enterprise\-grade Quote\-to\-Cash capability.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


**As a Technical Specialist Salesforce Revenue Cloud at LevelShift, you will:**


* Develop and customize Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce Platform technologies.
* Configure and enhance Product Catalogs, Pricing, Quoting, and Revenue Cloud capabilities to support end\-to\-end Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) business processes.
* Design and implement scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices, security standards, and enterprise architecture.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and custom Salesforce functionality based on business and technical requirements.
* Design and develop integrations between Salesforce, ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications using REST APIs and modern integration frameworks.
* Support data migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation, and data quality.
* Participate in solution design, technical estimation, development, testing, deployment, and release management activities.
* Work with solution architects and functional consultants to translate Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce coding standards, security best practices, integration patterns, and development guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Revenue Cloud, Apex, LWC, integrations, data, configurations, and Salesforce platform functionality.
* Support SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and technical issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain technical design documents, data mappings, integration specifications, deployment documents, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with QA teams to develop test scenarios, support defect resolution, and ensure solution quality.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and provide effective technical solutions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve Revenue Cloud processes, automation, system performance, scalability, and overall solution quality**.**
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance Salesforce development, solution design, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and engineering productivity while ensuring responsible AI usage.
* Utilize AI\-assisted development for Apex, LWC, Salesforce Flows, integrations, debugging, technical documentation, code reviews, and test\-case generation.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein AI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and improve solution delivery.
* Explore opportunities to use AI for Quote\-to\-Cash automation, business process optimization, data analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and developer productivity.
* Ensure AI\-assisted development follows appropriate data privacy, security, governance, and Salesforce development standards.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing Revenue Cloud development, testing, support, monitoring, and technical workflows.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* 57 years of experience in Salesforce development, implementation, technical consulting, or solution delivery, with strong hands\-on experience in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA).
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and Salesforce Platform.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Product Catalog, Pricing, Quoting, and Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) processes.
* Experience implementing and configuring Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) capabilities for enterprise business requirements.
* Strong experience developing custom Apex classes, triggers, LWC components, Flows, and Salesforce customizations.
* Experience designing and implementing REST API integrations between Salesforce and external applications.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications.
* Good understanding of data migration, data transformation, data validation, and Salesforce data management.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, governor limits, platform limitations, and development best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, version control, deployment processes, testing frameworks, and release management.
* Experience performing code reviews, technical troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and release activities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with architects, functional consultants, QA teams, integration teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver scalable solutions within project timelines.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce platform innovations, AI, integrations, and emerging Salesforce technologies.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Accelerate your career by working on enterprise\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash transformation initiatives for global customers.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to the latest Salesforce innovations, including Revenue Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein AI, and AI\-assisted development.
* Work with experienced Salesforce architects, consultants, developers, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Gain experience across challenging Revenue Cloud implementations, integrations, data migration, and enterprise application development.
* Build strong technical and consulting capabilities through continuous learning, certification support, technical mentoring, and challenging implementation projects.
* Be part of a culture that values innovation, technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, professional development programs, Salesforce certification support, and exposure to emerging Salesforce and AI technologies.

title: Data Quality Engineer

title: TIG Welder/Fabricator
description:
TIG WELDER JOB Description

The TIG Welder will be responsible for the fitfing arid welding of aluminium, stainless steels and nickel alioy products using the TIG process with a great deal of precision. A welder must also be competent in using potentially dangerous equipment following all safety precautions. The ideal candidate will have a steady hand, knowledge of various types of metal and their properties and great attention to detail

Responsibilities and Requirements:

Set up and operate welding machines to TIG weld aluminium components, thin (0\.032\) stainless steel and nickel alloy components

Read and interpret blueprints and drawings

TIG weld aluminium or steel based on specifications AWS and aerospace welding specifications

Weld custom work

Prepare weld joints by using hand grinders and sanders

Maintain equipment in a condition that does not compromise safety

Observe all safety rules

Preform other duties as require to complete the job

Critical thinking and problem\-solving skills

Education and Experience:

Completion of one\-year certification program in welding from college or technical school or Two\-years related experience and or training or equivalent combination of both

Must be able to pass a weld test

Experience in TIG welding required

Must be able to pass all pre\-employment requirements.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
